name: P-007 census guard catches a missing built-in SU contribution row
command: npm --prefix packages/operator-core test -- lib/agent-identities/source.test.ts -t 'reconciles every built-in SU contribution'
Repeat the same Vitest case with PAPERCUSP_MUTATION_PROBE_SOURCE pointing to a temporary copy of the census with only the su/current-mode-state row removed
summary: The committed real-suite census guard passed on the unchanged 24-row document and failed on a temporary 23-row copy-out mutant. The failure identified the omitted su/current-mode-state row at source.test.ts:38. The original census and test files were clean before and after the probe.

assertions.evidence: The focused Vitest case passed 1/1 on the original census; the command exited 0. The committed census SHA-256 was cc914edfc6ccced9e2222ab03349d72c4f87cf50a7630e626f7b6c748f91eac6.

Removing only the su/current-mode-state table row produced temporary mutant SHA-256 4e59d618f9ad68dad70a3f94b906279a630ddc0610db2dfcecd968358a566df2. The same focused Vitest case exited 1 and showed the missing key in the expected 24 versus received 23 comparison at source.test.ts:38.

The probe used a temporary copy through PAPERCUSP_MUTATION_PROBE_SOURCE and did not edit the canonical census or test. Both paths were git-clean; source.test.ts SHA-256 was a11df5e6797514b38dfacd60c9de2b9619a915db65a7c5cea42d5cecf6cbf746.

operatorPlane: canonical staging Vitest case with temporary copy-out input
limitation: This proves the census population detector. It does not by itself verify the 24 consumers or their live host effects; those require separate conventional and native receipts.
